install.title: Install PartyUp
install.body: Add it to your home screen for a full-screen app that opens faster.

ios.heading: Add PartyUp to your Home Screen
ios.description: Safari installs apps from its Share menu.
ios.step1: Tap the Share button in the Safari toolbar.
ios.step2: Scroll down and choose "Add to Home Screen".
ios.step3: Tap "Add" — PartyUp then opens full screen from your Home Screen.
